key.name: rbw-pinentry-bridge

key.description: Set by the preferences, which also point rbw's pinentry at the bridge script.

key.name: rbw-pinentry-fallback
key.summary: rbw's pinentry before the bridge was enabled; restored when it's disabled

key.name: onepassword-account

key.name: clear-clipboard-seconds
key.summary: Clear copied secrets after this many seconds (0 = never)

key.name: scrub-clipboard-history
key.summary: Remove copied secrets from Clipboard Indicator's history

key.name: type-delay-ms
key.summary: Delay between typed characters in milliseconds

key.name: submit-after-password
key.summary: Press Enter after typing a password

key.name: default-currency
key.summary: Currency that amounts like "100 usd" are converted to

key.name: clockify-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that opens the launcher straight in Clockify (optional)

key.name: clockify-api-url
key.summary: Clockify API base URL (regional servers use e.g. https://euc1.clockify.me/api/v1)
